titles.title: Crypto Advertising and Promotion Rules by Country
Global dataset of how regulators treat crypto ads, finfluencers and promotions

descriptions.description: A dataset of 58 crypto-asset advertising and promotion rules across 37 jurisdictions (36 countries and territories plus the EU). Each row records the regulator, instrument, status, effective date, treatment of crypto advertising, and whether licensing, risk warnings, influencer duties or incentive limits apply, with a source link and verification status. Updated quarterly. Information only, not legal advice.

Rules were found through regulator sites, official gazettes, legislatures, central banks and secondary trackers, and verified against primary sources where possible. Unverified rows are kept and explained in the notes column. Summaries are written in the maintainers' own words.
